title: Charles Buhler leaves NASA for propellantless propulsion based on Brown

tellings.quote: Not to mention [music] NASA's top scientist in electrostatics, Charles Beer, [music] literally leaving NASA to start a propellantless gravity-based propulsion system that he says is a derivative of Towns and Brown's [music] work.

plain: In the 2020s, Michels says, Charles Buhler, whom he calls NASA's top scientist in electrostatics, left NASA to start work on a gravity-based propulsion system that needs no fuel pushed out the back. Buhler says it derives from the work of Thomas Townsend Brown, an inventor who studied high-voltage effects decades earlier. Michels tells this himself, and for him it means Brown's ideas are being taken seriously today.
